description: A computed measurement of flow (velocity, time, load, efficiency, or distribution) for a value stream over a period, derived from mirrored work items.
A configured definition of a flow metric and its thresholds and targets, against which measured flow is evaluated.
Remediation tracking: owner, target date, evidence upload, closure date. Closure → closes corresponding GRC issue.
Deviation, complaint, or non-conformance event triggering investigation and corrective / preventive action (CAPA).
Historical comparison of submitted forecasts against actual closed results, used to measure forecast accuracy and train the forecasting models.
A manager override applied to a submitted forecast, capturing the changed number and the rationale for the adjustment.
A rep or manager submission for a forecast period, moving from draft to submitted to locked as the forecast cadence closes.
A targeted announcement sent to a frontline audience, with optional mandatory-read requirement, scheduled or supervisor-cascade delivery, and read/acknowledgment tracking.
A reusable template of ordered task items (opening, closing, audit, compliance) instantiated against a location and shift for frontline execution.
A per-worker record that a frontline learning module was completed, with score or pass status where the module is assessed.
A bite-size training unit delivered to frontline workers on a mobile device, with completion tracked per worker and role.
A delivery channel or stream (location feed, team channel, kiosk display, SMS fallback) through which broadcasts and conversations reach deskless workers.
A peer or manager recognition of a frontline worker, delivered in the frontline feed and visible to the team, tied to the recognized worker.
A per-worker submission completing a frontline task or checklist item, carrying the photo, form, or attestation evidence the task required.
A unit of work pushed to a frontline worker or location, completed on a mobile or shared device, with photo or form evidence collected on completion.
A reconciliation record for a fuel tank: opening volume, deliveries, pump totals, closing stick reading, and variance, kept for storage-tank compliance.
A fuel-dock transaction: product (gas or diesel), gallons, pump, price, and the boater or vessel charged.
A bulk fuel storage tank at the marina: product, capacity, and current volume, reconciled against deliveries and sales.
Fuel-card or charging-network transaction: vehicle, driver, fuel type and quantity, cost, location, time. Matched against vehicle assignments for IFTA reporting and exception detection.
Fulfillment instruction group created from order_lines; assigned to warehouse/location, tracked to shipment.
Accounting close cycles for the fund (monthly, quarterly, annual). Drives PCAP statement generation and audit packaging.
Waterfall payout from a real-estate fund to LPs and GP (preferred return, return-of-capital, catch-up, carried interest); calculated on income, sale, or refinancing events.
End-to-end fund-vehicle setup record: entity formation filings, EIN application, banking onboarding, templated LPA. Unique to emerging-manager bundled platforms.
GP-side accounting entries against the fund vehicle (contributions, expenses, fee accruals, gain/loss recognitions) with GAAP/IFRS conformance.
Fund-level performance reporting period: vintage-adjusted IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI with PME benchmarking, J-curve normalization.
Per-position return calculation: IRR/MOIC/TVPI/DPI on the fund's holding in a specific portfolio company, time-windowed.
Private-capital fund vehicle (LP/GP partnership structure) with vintage, strategy, target size, and current AUM. The structural backbone every other fund-admin module references.

Court-ordered or agency-issued instruction to withhold from an employee's wages (child support, tax levy, bankruptcy, student loan, creditor). Carries priority, ceiling, remit-to instructions, and lifecycle (active, released, exhausted).
GDPR Article 6 / 7 consent capture for learner training data: purpose, lawful basis, granted timestamp, withdrawal timestamp.
Account in the chart of accounts: code, name, type (asset/liability/equity/revenue/expense), normal balance, statutory mapping. The schema of the books.
Vehicle entry / exit across a defined geofence boundary.
Business-language definition of a concept: term name, definition, steward, domains, related terms, synonyms, certification status. Distinct from ontologies (formal RDF/OWL models).
Confirmation that ordered goods or services were received as expected: receipt date, quantity received, condition. The basis for 3-way matching against PO + invoice that AP runs before payment.
Continuous vehicle location stream (timestamp, lat, lon, speed, heading) — powers heat maps + geofence checks.
A grazing paddock or field: area, location, pasture type, carrying capacity, and rest state. The land unit grazing plans rotate mobs across.
A rotational-grazing plan over a set of paddocks and mobs: planned rotation order, rest periods, stocking rate, and carrying-capacity targets for a season or cycle.
The committed go-to-market plan for a period: the parent artifact that locks and pushes downstream. Mastered by every pure-play planning vendor.
A what-if model of the plan under alternative segment, territory, capacity, or channel assumptions.
Witnessed e-signature binding learner, course, content version and timestamp for FDA 21 CFR Part 11 life-sciences training.
Per-product Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point document: hazard analysis, CCPs, critical limits, monitoring procedures, corrective actions.
Statutory acknowledgment of harassment training completion per CA SB-1343, NY 201-g, IL 2-109; carries signed timestamp and IP.

Physical IT asset: laptop, desktop, server, mobile, network gear, peripheral. Carries serial number, MAC/asset tag, current user / location / room, lifecycle state, depreciation schedule, and procurement reference. The HAM master; CMDB models the same physical thing as a CI for the operational/topology view.
Decommissioning, e-waste tracking, ITAD chain-of-custody and data-wipe compliance for retired hardware.
Canonical catalog of hardware device types, SKUs and specifications; matches assets to refreshable units.
Manufacturer support contract / coverage terms / expiration tracking for a hardware asset.
Field-level harvest projection translated to available-share / SKU planning; drives reserve-list and dynamic pricing.
Per-field and per-zone yield record from combine telemetry, scale tickets, and grain-handling reconciliation.
A scheduled lift of a vessel out of and back into the water using a travel lift or crane, with stands time on the hard.
An identified workplace hazard, its source and affected tasks, and the controls applied to reduce its risk.

Approved slot in the org — a 'chair' with role definition, cost center, reporting line, location, and FTE allocation. Distinct from job_profiles (the catalog definition) and from employees (the person filling the slot). A position can be open, filled, or eliminated. SWP designs future positions via org_designs; HCM operationalizes them once approved.

Period-by-period headcount targets (typically monthly or quarterly) broken down by org unit, location, function, level, and employment type. Includes opening balance, additions (hires, transfers in), reductions (attrition, RIF, transfers out), and target end-of-period count. The basis for plan-vs-actual reconciliation against HCM.
Helm deployment tracking: chart name/version, values overrides, release namespace, installed status.
The headcount plan that closes the capacity gap: roles, timing, and ramp, handed to Recruiting and Finance.

Per-requisition role-scoped staffing junction: assigns specific users to recruiter, hiring manager, coordinator, interviewer, and reviewer roles on a single requisition. Captures team composition without requiring global RBAC for transient interview-panel membership.
Binding between visitor and internal employee host: access scope, duration window, responsible party for visitor supervision.

Employee inquiry or service request routed to HR Operations (pay question, benefits change, policy clarification, leave request, complaint). The HRSD analog of ITSM service_requests, scoped to HR-owned workflows.

A work item generated by a user task in a running process: an assignable, claimable unit of human work with candidate users and groups, due date, priority, and form, completed by a person to advance the instance.
Bucket policy, RBAC assignment, RBAC rule, SaaS role grant, database permission. Infrastructure-level IAM artifact. Distinct from DCG `data_access_policies` (governance policy).
A definition of the best-fit account: firmographics, technographics, and qualifying criteria. Authored here and consumed by the ABM platform for engagement.

Identity-resolution edges: email ↔ device ↔ cookie ↔ login ↔ phone. The graph that turns anonymous interactions into resolved customers. Built up over time from event signals; quality drives every downstream activation. IGA contributes employee-as-customer overlap for B2C-employer scenarios.
Engine-running, vehicle-stationary state change — distinct from trip aggregation.

ML or rule-based model trained to extract structured fields from documents (invoices, contracts, forms, receipts). Carries model_type, training lineage, performance metrics, version, deployment_status. Distinct from MLM `ml_models` (generic ML registry).
Reusable definition per document type: field structure, validation rules, target_system mapping. Distinct from ECM `document_classifications` (taxonomy) and CLM `contract_templates` (assembly).
Validation outcome for an extracted record/field set. Carries validation_rule_id, status (pass / fail / review), exception_details, validator_id (automated / human), resolution_state.
Access review / certification campaign and per-user attestation outcome.
User-initiated access request + approval workflow within an IGA platform.
Business-role / entitlement template provisioned into downstream systems — distinct from Semantius platform roles.
Per-target outcome of an IGA-orchestrated provisioning action (success, failure, retry).
Segregation-of-duties policy violation and exception-approval record.

IGA's governance view of a user's access to an application: the entitlement grant, who requested it, who approved it, when it was last certified, and when it was revoked. Driven by birthright policy plus access-request workflow. Correlates with an smp_license_seat_assignment (the seat/cost view of the same access fact); the two routinely diverge.

In-house legal matter (dispute / transaction / advisory / IP case / regulatory response): client department, opposing parties, matter type, key dates, assigned in-house counsel + outside counsel, budget, status. Scope-qualified to distinguish from law-firm `legal_matters` (id 391, LEGAL-PRACT-MGMT-mastered).
Proactive incident forecast (likely unplanned change → service impact in N hours) — higher-level than per-signal anomaly.

Physical plant, equipment, or infrastructure tracked for maintenance and lifecycle: HVAC units, generators, pumps, conveyors, production-line machines, building systems. Carries asset_tag, location, manufacturer, install_date, criticality, current_state. The EAM master; distinct from HAM `hardware_assets` (IT gear: laptops, servers, network), `fixed_assets` (ERP-FIN capitalization view of the same physical thing), and CMDB `configuration_items` (logical/topological IT view).
An industrial-hygiene sampling or exposure-monitoring result for a chemical, noise, or other agent, measured against occupational exposure limits and linked to the exposed workers and tasks.

Creator/influencer profile managed in influencer-marketing tools: audience metrics, content history, contracts, payments, and campaign attribution. Distinct from contacts (which represent customer/prospect individuals).

Purchase order from the agency to a specific media outlet (publisher, broadcaster, platform) committing budget at negotiated rates with commission terms and make-good provisions. Reconciled against the media outlet's invoice.
A prioritized alert raised when correlated indicators cross a risk threshold for a user. Triaged and dispositioned, and escalated into an insider-risk case when warranted.

An investigation case opened on a suspected insider threat. Carries the full lifecycle from triage through investigation to disposition, the activity timeline, linked evidence, and the HR/Legal handoff.

Customer-owned equipment that the service organization installs and maintains. Carries identity (manufacturer, model, serial), placement (customer_site), and lifecycle state (active, out_of_service, decommissioned). The asset register that work orders are performed against and service contracts cover.
Junction assigning an instructor to a session or offering, with role (primary / assistant / observer).
Instructor master separate from employees; covers internal trainers, contracted SMEs, and external vendor instructors.

Master record from first notice of loss through adjudication and settlement; P&C and life insurance scope. Carries claim type, loss date, reported date, claimant, adjuster, status (open / in-investigation / settled / closed / litigated), gross/net liability. Scope-qualified to avoid collision with HR claims, warranty claims, healthcare claims.

Underwritten contract defining coverage terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions, effective/expiration dates; the contractual artifact a claim is filed against. Distinct from GRC `policies` (control documents) and tenant lease policies.
Vendor connector definition (per third-party application) with auth_type (OAuth / API key / basic / mTLS).
Transformation rule: source_field → target_field, mapping_logic, transformation_type (direct / computed / lookup).
Higher-level orchestration composing multiple pipelines and connectors. Note potential overlap with DATA-AI-PLAT `data_pipelines` — DI lens is integration-tool, DATA-AI-PLAT lens is platform-engine.
Named, versioned template for recurring event-driven flows (recipes, processes, workflows).
Execution log per recipe invocation: timestamp, status, input_id, output_id, error_log, latency_ms.
Event source (scheduled / webhook / database-change / queue) with polling or push config.
A configured source feeding competitive intelligence (news, review sites, web monitors, field reports).
Intent specification — training phrases, entities, resolution rules — drives detection at runtime.

An NLU output record: detected intent classification, confidence, originating utterance, downstream action taken. Decoupled from conversation_transcripts so intent analytics can roll up independently of transcript retention policy.
A captured buying-intent signal for an account or contact, with topic, source, and strength.

A supervisor's quality review of a recorded interaction, scored against an evaluation form, with section and item scores, comments, agent acknowledgment, and a coaching follow-up flag. Moves through draft, scoring, completed, disputed, and calibrated states.
Transaction between two legal_entities of the same group: intercompany invoice, transfer, allocation. Drives elimination entries at consolidation.
Patron-initiated request to borrow material from another library, including routing across sharing partners, shipping status, and fulfillment workflow.
Internal postings covering full-time roles, gigs, projects, stretch assignments, and mentorships.
Reusable interview template per role / stage. Bundles assigned questions, target competencies, recommended scorecard, expected duration. Greenhouse's core authoring unit.
